notes.title: Official Release - The Territory of Egg 2
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863780/_2/
Hello everyone, The Territory of Egg 2 is now officially released with a discount of 25%. We are also introducing a bundle package with the The Territory of Egg, which includes an additional 10% discount. Players who already own the The Territory of Egg can purchase the bundle for even more savings!

Lead the Egg Warriors to light up the dark forests, build defenses, awaken the spirits of ancient heroes, and battle lurking enemies by combining skill branches and evolutions.

Evolutions in The Territory of Egg 2

 New Strategy Gameplay: Introducing powerful Heroic Eggs, more new skills, and enemy types to greatly enhance strategic depth!
 Art Optimizations: We’ve partnered with a professional art director to deliver a more immersive visual experience.
 More Levels and Challenges: The sequel offers more new levels than the first game, with various difficulty modes for you to tackle.


if you have feedback or questions about the game, please Join our Discord and leave your comments!

notes.title: Hawthorn Games' TD Game Collection - Available Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the bundle "Hawthorn Games' TD Game Collection" is now available. You can enjoy a 10% discount purchasing the bundle.

The bundle includes two TD Games from Hawthorn Games:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577520/_/

You will act as the Lord of Foe in Game Development Council, who decided to go his separate way due to a conflict. Invade the newly released game Village Guardian. Summon the Predators to destroy villages. Try your best to overthrow the Overlord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318630/_/

Try your best to build defense lines with egg warriors to protect the Holy Egg, the core of all eggs. Remember to upgrade your Tech Tree with the resources you've collected and unlock more skills to fight against the evil monsters.

notes.title: The Territory of Egg 2 - Store Page Launched!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863780/_2/

The sequel The Territory of Egg 2 has officially launched its store page. Please follow and wishlist us now!

The Territory of Egg 2 has evolved while retaining the core gameplay of the original:

Art
The art for the eggs, enemies, maps, and more has been fully improved.

New Eggs
Introducing "Heroic Eggs," powerful eggs that will appear on the battlefield waiting to be activated.

Challenge Modes
In addition to brand new levels, each level offers multiple difficulty modes for players to challenge.

Our latest PV: [previewyoutube=ikq_pCQlj_M;full][/previewyoutube]

See you again in the future!

notes.title: The Territory of Egg - Bug Fix and Balance Change
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Please check our latest update:


Fix a bug that sometimes enemies may not get the correct status.
Raged Bosses are now immune to stun.


The Territory of Egg has officially released on Steam! Don't forget to Join our Discord.

notes.title: The Territory of Egg - Evolution Reroll and Monster Encyclopaedia
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Please check our latest update:


You can now cost the reroll chance to reroll the evolution! Whenever you clear 10 waves, you will get 1 reroll chance.
Add the Monster Encyclopaedia, and you can check the details of every monster you've ever encountered. You can find the Monster Encyclopaedia on the left side of the screen.


The Territory of Egg has officially released on Steam! Don't forget to Join our Discord.

notes.title: The Territory of Egg - Sound Effects, 0.5x Game Speed, and Egg Clone!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Please check our latest update:


Adjust lighting eggs' sound effects.
You can now set the game at 0.5x speed. 
Complement the Egg Clone function. You can copy an advanced eggs with all learnt skills to other placeable plots.


The Territory of Egg has officially released on Steam! Don't forget to Join our Discord.

notes.title: The Territory of Egg – Tips Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Please check our latest update:


 Add a tip after defeating enemy lords to inform players how to unlock new levels.
 The button of the BOOK OF EGG will keep flickering now when there are new contents unlocked.
 Improve the description of the hint messages about ethereal and invisible enemies.

notes.title: Minor Balance Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Please check our latest update:

1. Buff Marbles: The bullets will have double movement distance after bouncing.
2. Add a tutorial about how to transfer the savedata from the Demo to the full release version. You can click the button at the top of the main menu to check.
